visual_action: The video is a slideshow of three images. The first is a close-up of a traditional, oval 'I Voted' sticker with an American flag on it, stuck to denim fabric. The second is a screenshot of a news article from WAFB 9 News, headlined 'Louisiana unveils new ‘I Voted’ sticker featuring crawfish named “Mark de Ballot”'. The article shows two people holding up a large version of the new sticker. The third image is a close-up of the new sticker itself, which is circular and yellow, featuring a cartoon crawfish dressed in a blue suit and a top hat, with the words 'I VOTED' above it.
